parrafo_1.es: Total Flooring Systems es un negocio local de Cape Coral especializado en pisos y tile. Ayudamos a elegir el material correcto para cada espacio e instalamos con un equipo propio y responsable.
parrafo_1.en: Total Flooring Systems is a local Cape Coral business focused on flooring and tile. We help you pick the right material for every space and install it with our own, accountable crew.

parrafo_2.es: Nuestros clientes vuelven a llamarnos para el siguiente proyecto: lo dicen en sus propias reseñas, trabajo tras trabajo.
parrafo_2.en: Our clients keep calling us for the next project: they say so in their own reviews, job after job.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué espacio quieres renovar. Jennifer te ayuda a elegir entre las opciones de marca y material.
texto.en: Tell us which space you want to renovate. Jennifer helps you choose from the brand and material options.

texto.es: Te decimos qué lleva el trabajo y cuánto cuesta antes de empezar, sin sorpresas a mitad de obra.
texto.en: We tell you what the job takes and what it costs before starting, no mid-job surprises.

texto.es: Nuestros instaladores llegan puntuales y trabajan con el cuidado que destacan nuestras reseñas.
texto.en: Our installers arrive on time and work with the care our reviews point out again and again.

texto.es: Revisamos juntos el resultado y dejamos el área limpia cada día de trabajo, hasta el final.
texto.en: We walk the result together and leave the area clean every day of the job, through to the end.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el material y la superficie. Llámanos y Jennifer te da el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the material and the surface. Call us and Jennifer will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Porcelanato, madera y laminado tipo madera, instalados con la preparación correcta para que duren.
texto.en: Porcelain, wood and wood-look laminate, installed with the right prep so they last.

texto.es: Reemplazo completo de ducha, incluyendo base Schluter, con acabados que nuestros clientes describen como impecables.
texto.en: Full shower replacement, including a Schluter pan, with finishes our clients describe as flawless.

texto.es: Tile y revestimiento de cocina a medida, coordinado con tu encimera y tus gabinetes.
texto.en: Custom kitchen tile and surfaces, coordinated with your counters and cabinets.

texto.es: Si no sabes qué tile o color elegir, Jennifer busca opciones hasta encontrar la que encaja con tu espacio.
texto.en: If you are not sure which tile or color to pick, Jennifer searches until she finds the one that fits your space.

pie.es: ¿Buscas un material específico? Llámanos: tenemos acceso a marcas como Shaw, Daltile y Mohawk.
pie.en: Looking for a specific material? Call us: we have access to brands like Shaw, Daltile and Mohawk.

items.quote: Total Flooring does all of our flooring, shower enclosures and back splash work. Basically any floors or tile work they do it all. Jennifer is an excellent designer and their installers are exceptional! Thank you Total Flooring for the many years of hard work.

We had a total shower replacement including the Schluter System pan, and we're very happy with how it turned out. Jennifer and Josh were very friendly and helpful without being pushy. Our installers Joseph and George were excellent. They did a great job and were very professional, arriving on time every day and working hard all day.

My home was all carpet for years. We finally decided to switch to tile, wood-style. We are beyond pleased with, Total flooring helping us making our home beautiful again! The tile workers are very professional and kind, and most importantly they did an excellent job!
